data: Browse the documentation to get started with templify.
Bundle templates are Go html/template files.
data.formatting#Formatting: Function Description currency f Formats as 1 234,56 €
data.math#Math: Function Signature Description toFloat string → float64 Parses numbers with spaces, commas, or € suffix add float64, float64 → float64 Addition sub float64, float64 → float64 Subtraction mul float64, float64 → float64 Multiplication pct base, rate → float64 base × rate / 100 sumProductLast [][]string → float64 Σ(col[n-2] × col[n-1]) — last two columns sumProduct [][]string, colA, colB → float64 Σ(colA[i] × colB[i]) sumCol [][]string, col → float64 Sum of one column
data.table-helpers#Table helpers: Function Description rowSlice rows from rows[from:] cell row i row[i] with bounds check lastCell row Last cell of a row prevCell row Second-to-last cell initCells row All cells except the last two
data.template-context#Template context: type Document struct { Title string Author string Date string Body template.HTML // rendered HTML body — do not re-escape PreTOC template.HTML // pre-TOC sections extracted from body Meta map[string]any // all front matter fields TOC []TocEntry Figures []FigureEntry Sections map[string]Section // h2 sections keyed by heading text } type Section struct { HTML template.HTML Table [][]string // row 0 = headers, row 1+ = data } .Config (*config.Config) and .ConfigCSS (template.HTML) are also available on every render.

data:
A bundle is a directory containing:
main.html — Go html/template for the document body (required) cover.html — optional cover page template default.yml — optional config defaults specific to this bundle Built-in bundles are embedded in the binary. You can also use a local directory via -bundle ./my-bundle/.

You can use a local directory as a bundle. Pass its path to -bundle:
templify -input document.md -bundle ./my-bundle/ -output document.pdf
data.cover-page#Cover page: If cover.html is present and cover.enabled: true, it is rendered as a separate named page. Any
data.defaultyml#default.yml:
Values in default.yml are layered on top of the global defaults and under the user’s -config file. Only set values that differ from the defaults.
cover: enabled: false page: size: A4 margins: top: 14mm right: 14mm bottom: 14mm left: 14mm custom: mybundle: some_option: "value"
data.directory-structure#Directory structure: my-bundle/ ├── main.html # required — Go html/template ├── cover.html # optional cover page └── default.yml # optional config defaults

data:
The invoice bundle produces a single-page invoice with automatic HT / TVA / TTC calculation.
templify -input invoice.md -bundle invoice -config invoice.yml -output invoice.pdf
data.config-options#Config options: # invoice.yml custom: invoice: logo: "./logo.svg" show: logo: true due_date: true labels: client: "Facturer à" total_ht: "Total HT" vat: "TVA" total_ttc: "Total TTC"
data.document-structure#Document structure:
Sections are defined as h2 headings in the Markdown file.
Section Description ## Vendeur Vendor information (address, SIRET, …) ## Client Client address ## Articles Line items table ## Conditions Payment terms, footer text
data.items-table#Items table:
The last two columns are always interpreted as quantity × unit price. Any number of descriptive columns can precede them.
## Articles | Description | Unité | Qté | Prix HT | |---|---|---|---| | Développement API | jour | 5 | 800,00 | | Formation | forfait | 1 | 400,00 | HT, TVA, and TTC totals are computed automatically.

data:
The quote bundle produces a single-page quote (devis). It follows the same structure as the invoice bundle but uses quote-specific fields and an optional VAT display.
templify -input quote.md -bundle quote -config quote.yml -output quote.pdf
data.config-options#Config options: # quote.yml custom: quote: logo: "./logo.svg" show: logo: false validity_date: true vat: true # set to false for HT-only total labels: client: "Adresser à" validity: "Valable jusqu'au" total_ht: "Total HT" vat: "TVA" total_ttc: "Total TTC" When vat: false, the totals block shows a single HT line — useful for freelancers on franchise de base or when VAT is not applicable.
data.document-structure#Document structure: Section Description ## Vendeur Vendor information ## Client Client address ## Articles Line items table (same convention as invoice) ## Conditions Validity terms, footer text

data:
The report bundle produces a multi-page document with a cover page, table of contents, and configurable header/footer. It is the default bundle.
templify -input document.md -bundle report -output document.pdf
data.bibliography--sitography#Bibliography \u: references: bibliography: "Bibliographie" sitography: "Sitographie" List items are formatted as [n] numbered references. Use ordered lists in your source so numbers are predictable.
data.front-matter#Front matter: --- title: My Report author: Alice date: 2026-05-06 header: left: "My Company" right: "Confidential" footer: right: "{page} / {pages}" --- {page} and {pages} are replaced with the current page number and total page count.
data.markdown-features#Markdown features: GFM — tables, strikethrough, task lists Footnotes — rendered inline at the bottom of the page where the reference appears Definition lists Typographer — smart quotes, dashes Image captions — set the title attribute on an image: ![alt](image.png "This becomes a figcaption")
data.table-of-figures#Table of figures:
Set references.figures in your config to the h2 heading text. The section content is replaced with an auto-generated table.
references: figures: "Table des illustrations"

data:
Configuration is layered — each level overrides the previous:
Built-in defaults Bundle default.yml User -config file Front matter (header/footer slots only)
data.bundle-specific-options#Bundle-specific:
Options under custom: are accessible in templates via .Config.CustomString and .Config.CustomBool:
custom: invoice: show: logo: true logo: ./logo.svg {{- $showLogo := .Config.CustomBool "invoice.show.logo" false -}} {{- $logoPath := .Config.CustomString "invoice.logo" "" -}}
data.colors-as-css-variables#Colors as CSS va: Variable Config key --blue colors.primary --blue-light colors.primary_light --bg-soft colors.background --text colors.text --text-muted colors.text_muted
data.full-reference#Full reference: page: size: A4 margins: top: 25mm right: 20mm bottom: 25mm left: 25mm font: family: Inter url: https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@400;600&display=swap size: 11pt line_height: 1.6 justify: false paragraph_indent: 13mm heading_indent: 5mm heading_numbers: enabled: true exclude: - Introduction - Conclusion toc: enabled: true max_depth: 3 exclude: - Remerciements pre_toc: - Remerciements references: bibliography: "Bibliographie" sitography: "Sitographie" figures: "Table des illustrations" header: enabled: true background: "linear-gradient(to right, #1e293b, #475569)" left: "" center: "" right: "" footer: enabled: true background: "" left: "" center: "" right: "{page} / {pages}" blank_page: false colors: primary: "#1e293b" primary_light: "#475569" background: "#f8fafc" text: "#0f172a" text_muted: "#64748b" cover: enabled: true template: "" custom: {}

data.built-in-bundles#Built-in bundles: Bundle Description report Multi-page document with cover, TOC, and header/footer invoice Single-page invoice with automatic HT/TVA/TTC totals quote Single-page quote with optional VAT display
data.cli-flags#CLI flags: Flag Default Description -input — Path to the input Markdown file (required) -output output.pdf Path for the generated PDF -bundle report Built-in bundle name or path to a local bundle directory -config — YAML config file overlaid on top of the bundle defaults
data.installation#Installation:
go install github.com/tomsiouan/templify@latest Or build from source:
git clone https://github.com/tomsiouan/templify cd templify go build -o build/templify . Chromium is auto-downloaded to ~/.cache/rod/ on first run. No other dependencies required.
data.your-first-pdf#Your first PDF:
templify -input document.md -output document.pdf With a config file:
templify -input document.md -bundle report -config config.yml -output document.pdf
